fit: formula and retrospective repeated stool counts
assessment: Weekly frequency rose from a baseline median of two. Both dose groups received the whole product and there was no untreated comparison. This provides a stool-count observation outside the frozen preparation and population.

assessment: The 63-person placebo trial favored the global treatment assessment and stool form. Frequency and straining changes were inconclusive. The product and unclear administered amount are distinct from a grated-ginger contrast.
